\begin{aligned}
f(x)&=- 4 x^{\frac{1}{2}} + 3 x + 2, \\f'(x)&=3 - \frac{2}{x^{\frac{1}{2}}}=3 - \frac{2}{\sqrt{x}}.
\end{aligned}

$$
\begin{aligned}

\end{aligned}

y-(1)&=-1(x-(1)), \\y&=- x + 2.
\end{aligned}

\begin{aligned}

\end{aligned}
